text.text: This portfolio extends the proven innovations of Cisco Unified Fabric innovations to the High-Frequency Trading (HFT) market and Big Data environments. They deliver: Ultra-low, sub-microsecond latency Line-rate L2/L3 switching Identical shared memory switch architecture for 1/10/40 GbE connectivity Low power consumption Suite of manageability tools for ease of deployment like that of DCNM, Python Scripting, Power-On auto provisioning, XML and others.

text.text: Cisco Nexus 3000 Series portfolio is an ideal solution in the High Frequency Trading and Big Data environments. It delivers an ultra-low latency, high performing wire rate Layer 3 solution that provide different connectivity options 1GbE to 40GbE. It also delivers simplified management features including Python scripting, EEM, and XML management tools. The portfolio consists of 4 switch models: Nexus 3548, Nexus 3064, Nexus 3016, and Nexus 3048 Switches.

text.text: The Cisco Nexus 3064 Switch, part of the Unified Fabric family, is a compact 1-rack-unit (1RU) form factor switch. It delivers ultra-low latency, low power, and wire-rate Layer 2/3 10GbE switching on a data center class Cisco NX-OS operating system. It is ideal for High Frequency Trading markets and large financial deployments.
